text: Implemented V009/current authority adapter, unified LocalOnly policy events for organization/grants/API credentials, stable grant-intent retries and offboarding invalidation. First focused run: 66 tests passed (41 new authority, 11 organization persistence, 10 transactions, 4 runtime privileges). Added further runtime/event rollback and appointment-lineage coverage; full regression running. Independent witness/recovery remains unimplemented; no completion claim yet.
